headline: Gakpo Cut Short, test211 In The Dark
deck: Cody Gakpo, owned by test211, hurt on international duty; no timeline given.
body:
Add Cody Gakpo to the international break's casualty list, and add test211 to the managers left waiting on it. His Nations League involvement was curtailed by injury, alongside Bruno Fernandes and Patrick Dorgu, and that is as far as the wire will take us.

What it costs test211, and for how long, nobody has said. No return date has been put on Gakpo. Until one is, test211 plans a Gameweek 6 line-up around a forward whose fitness is another country's business.
